title: deaddrop: 24-bit predictable drop IDs enable enumeration; group drops leak existence via 4.03
description: deaddrop.rs:897-911 generate_drop_id masks splitmix64(now ^ counter) to 0xFF_FFFF - no entropy beyond 24-bit output space; GET /deaddrop/{id} is unrate-limited so 2^24 enumeration is hours of traffic; 4.03 for group drops confirms existence/ACL boundary to non-recipients (:1156-1163), public drops leak content. 6-hex length is spec-baked (18.9 example) so unpredictability is the achievable fix. Fix: derive IDs from CSPRNG (getrandom; std crate) or HMAC(server_secret, context||counter); consider counting misses against a limiter. Keep vector conformance (vectors pin format, not entropy).
